initial.title: [v0.92.2][planning] Audit and refresh first-pass milestone documentation
initial.goal: Produce a coherent, reviewed, number-free first-pass v0.92.2 planning package and explicitly disposition relevant unplanned or unscheduled TBD material.
initial.required_outcome: The canonical planning package, feature set, issue wave, execution specifications, sprint structure, release tail, and TBD scheduling reconciliation agree without opening the milestone or creating implementation issues.
authority_boundary: #620 prepares documentation but does not open v0.92.2
The existing v0.92.2 package is the baseline to audit rather than recreate
Unresolved scheduling gaps require operator judgment and are not silently scheduled
Existing GitHub issue and completion truth prevents duplicate planning
operator_constraints: Do not create WP-01, sprint umbrellas, or child implementation issues
Do not create the milestone or version label
Do not implement product, Runtime, provider, cloud, or Unity features
Do not edit or delete TBD sources merely to clean the inventory
Do not broaden v0.92.2 with explicitly deferred work
initial.task_boundary: Audit and reconcile the existing v0.92.2 planning documents and produce a complete disposition of relevant TBD inputs.
deliverables: Aligned machine-readable issue wave and execution specifications
Review handoff with deferrals and operator decisions
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Every canonical planning document exists and agrees on purpose, scope, dependencies, sequencing, and planned posture
AC-2: Every first-class work track has a feature document, work-package home, proof expectation, and readiness disposition
AC-3: Every planned issue is one bounded unit of work with a concrete deliverable and acceptance denominator
AC-4: The catalog, issue wave, execution specifications, readiness table, and sprint plan have exact work-package parity
AC-5: The ten-step release tail is consistent across every planning surface
AC-6: Every relevant active TBD source has a source path, status, proposed home, rationale, and unresolved-decision field
AC-7: Unplanned or unscheduled TBD material is explicit while backlog and later-milestone work remains deferred
AC-8: Existing issues and completed work are reconciled without duplicate or reopened scope
AC-9: Links resolve, YAML parses, machine-local paths and unresolved placeholders are rejected, and diff hygiene passes
AC-10: Bounded independent review has no unresolved actionable finding before publication
dependencies: Operator authorization is required before v0.92.2 milestone opening or WP-01 creation
non_goals: Open the v0.92.2 milestone or create its version label
Silently schedule deferred or unresolved work
Run broad Rust or Runtime validation
initial.plan_summary: Establish the canonical denominator, audit relevant TBD and issue truth, reconcile all planning surfaces, validate the package, and prepare a findings-first review handoff.

steps.action: Build the canonical document, feature, work-package, sprint, and release-tail denominator.
Audit relevant active TBD sources and existing issue truth into explicit scheduling dispositions.
Reconcile the complete planning package so every issue is bounded and all machine and human surfaces agree.
Run focused structural, YAML, link, placeholder, scheduling-coverage, and diff-hygiene validation.
Prepare the review handoff, resolve actionable findings, and leave the package planned and number-free.

invariants: Complete and explicit TBD disposition denominator
One concrete result per planned issue
risks: Treating a stale TBD inventory as complete
Converting broad feature bundles into nominal single issues
Opening the milestone through documentation overclaim
stop_conditions: The canonical package denominator cannot be established
A relevant TBD source lacks a truthful disposition
Machine-readable and human-readable work-package identities disagree
A proposed scope move requires operator judgment
An actionable review finding remains unresolved

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove the canonical package and machine-readable planning surfaces are present and structurally readable.
Prove the relevant TBD denominator has explicit, non-silent scheduling dispositions.
Prove issue granularity, cross-file consistency, review handoff, and exact-range diff hygiene.

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on an incomplete package or TBD denominator, missing disposition, cross-file identity drift, unresolved placeholder, machine-local path, duplicate scope, silent scheduling decision, or unresolved actionable review finding.
review_prompts: Does the package include every canonical document and first-class feature surface?
Does each planned issue describe one bounded unit with a concrete result?
Is every relevant TBD source explicitly scheduled, deferred, preserved as reference or provenance, or flagged for operator decision?
Does the plan avoid duplicating existing and completed issues?
Does the package remain number-free and refrain from opening the milestone?
initial.review_scope: The v0.92.2 planning package, relevant TBD scheduling dispositions, existing-issue reconciliation, planned issue granularity, release-tail consistency, and milestone-opening boundary only.
